title: 第24章 投枪第25章 争夺任务
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
“数以十万计怪物组成的军团，也无法抵挡皇帝陛下的伟力！各种森林巨怪、沼泽巨妖、鹰身女妖、荆棘树妖、瘟疫鼠群、多头巨蛇、巨齿蛇龙、毒刺飞龙、蝎尾狮、还有数之不尽的哥布林和狗头人奴仆……”
吟游诗人仿佛报菜名一般，将一大串怪物的名字说出，每一种单个出动都是极其强大，足以轻易摧毁村落的怪物，如果组成军团，那破坏力真是难以想象的强大。
但皇帝陛下就如同真神下凡，一剑便砍下身高九米的巨妖头颅，一矛就扎穿硬度堪比精金的魔法傀儡，呼气将毒刺飞龙的毒雾吹回去，战吼震杀铺天盖地的瘟疫巨鼠……
其中情景描绘得仿若让人置身于现场一般，会因为听到怪物的描述而背生冷汗，会因为怪物被斩杀而心生感激。
“这是魔法？”
沃尔最开始听着也是热血沸腾，恨不得上去杀怪物的是自己，但很快感觉意识深处的战旗将自己身上某些力量驱散，内心便平静下来。
不过他倒也没有选择离开，既然都无法影响了，那就继续听呗。
听了大概一个小时，沃尔便大概听完了完整的事情经过。
在一个月之前，帝国皇帝便以恶龙残害生灵，罪不可赦为由发动秘密的讨伐战。
而在昨天晚上，帝国皇帝终于斩下了传奇绿龙的头颅，再次屠龙成功，这才解除禁令，允许吟游诗人们传唱皇帝这又一次的伟业。
魔法力量是极其便利的，这才第二天，基本上整个帝国较大的城镇都知晓了这个大事件。
沃尔抬头看向略显阴沉的天空，和往日没什么不同。
那传奇绿龙经营数百年的龙巢，竟然就在距离骏鹰山脉往东几百公里外的狮鹫山脉中。
难以想象，前一个月，在沃尔过着磕磕绊绊的冒险者生活时，那里正发生着何等惊人的战争！
“传奇，巨龙，竟然这么近，又那么远……”
心中呢喃着，沃尔往台上扔下10枚铜币，带着意犹未尽的霍恩和扎木合，还有偶遇的几个士兵一起离开。
好不容易挤出冒险者广场，霍恩和扎木合还很是亢奋，幻想中如果能够和皇帝陛下一起征讨恶龙，那多是一件美事啊！
不过他们也没忘了眼前的沃尔，毕竟皇帝陛下远在天边，眼前这位才是衣食父母。
“队长！那吟游诗人说骏鹰山脉东方现在有很多流窜的怪物，我们要不要去看看！”
队伍中最活泼的阿尔文提议，士兵们都是心情激荡，那些怪物不过是流窜的散兵游勇，那不是行走的奖金嘛。

沃尔瞥了阿尔文一眼，佯装疑惑道：
“我们去做什么？怕那些怪物在逃命的路上饿肚子？”
阿尔文拍拍胸脯，自信地说：
“我这几天胖了很多，到时候我去做诱饵，那些怪物肯定忍不住！”
众人一阵哄闹，虽然是在开玩笑，但众人内心都升起一种希望，跟着沃尔，或许不能像帝国皇帝一样成为传奇屠龙者，但离开城镇去猎杀怪物，却不再是幻想。
一行人很快来到铁锄头铁匠铺，但今天这里很是安静，只有加雷斯坐在门口打磨着手中的剑柄。
“日安，加雷斯先生。”
沃尔打了个招呼。
content_en:
"An army composed of hundreds of thousands of monsters cannot withstand the power of His Majesty the Emperor! All kinds of forest monsters, swamp monsters, harpies, thorn tree demons, plague rats, multi-headed giant snakes, giant toothed snake dragons, stinging dragons, manticores, and countless goblins and kobold slaves..."
The bard spoke out the names of a large list of monsters as if they were announcing the names of dishes. Each monster individually was extremely powerful and could easily destroy the village. If formed into a legion, the destructive power would be unimaginably powerful.
But His Majesty the Emperor was like a true god coming down to earth. He cut off the head of a nine-meter-tall giant demon with one sword, pierced the magic puppet as hard as fine gold with one spear, blew back the poisonous mist of the stinging flying dragon with his breath, and killed the overwhelming giant plague rats with his war roar...
The scenes are described as if you are at the scene. You will break out in a cold sweat when you hear the description of the monster, and you will feel grateful because the monster was killed.
"Is this magic?"
Wall's blood was boiling when he heard it at first, wishing that he was the one to go up and kill the monster, but soon he felt the battle flag deep in his consciousness dissipate some of the power in him, and he calmed down.
But he didn't choose to leave. Since he couldn't influence it, he just continued to listen.
After listening for about an hour, Wall roughly heard the complete story.
A month ago, the emperor of the empire launched a secret crusade on the grounds that the evil dragon harmed living creatures and was an unpardonable crime.
And last night, the emperor finally beheaded the legendary green dragon and successfully slayed the dragon again. Then the ban was lifted and the bards were allowed to sing about the emperor's great deeds.
Magical power is extremely convenient. It was only the second day, and basically all the larger towns in the empire knew about this major event.
Wall looked up at the slightly gloomy sky, which was no different from the past.
The dragon's nest that the legendary green dragon has been operating for hundreds of years is actually located in the Griffin Mountains, hundreds of kilometers east of the Hippogriff Mountains.
It is unimaginable that a month ago, when Wall was living a stumbling life as an adventurer, what an astonishing war was taking place there!
"The legend, the giant dragon, is so close yet so far..."
Whispering in his heart, Wall threw 10 copper coins on the stage and left with Horn and Zhamu, who were still interested, as well as a few soldiers he met by chance.
After finally squeezing out of the Adventurer's Plaza, Horn and Zamuhe were still very excited. In their fantasy, it would be a beautiful thing if they could conquer the evil dragon with His Majesty the Emperor!
However, they did not forget about Wall in front of them. After all, His Majesty the Emperor was far away, and this person in front of them was the one who provided food and clothing.
"Captain! The bard said that there are many monsters wandering east of the Hippogriff Mountains. Should we go and take a look!"
Alvin, the liveliest person in the team, suggested that the soldiers were all in agitated moods, and those monsters were just wandering stragglers, and that wasn't a walking bonus.
Wall glanced at Alvin and pretended to be confused:
"What are we going to do? Are we afraid that those monsters will starve on the way to escape?"
Alvin patted his chest and said confidently:
"I've gained a lot of weight these days. When the time comes to make bait, those monsters will definitely not be able to bear it!"
Everyone was making noises. Although it was a joke, everyone had a hope in their hearts. Following Wall, they might not be able to become a legendary dragon slayer like the emperor of the empire, but leaving the town to hunt monsters was no longer a fantasy.
The group of people soon arrived at the Iron Hoe Blacksmith Shop, but it was very quiet today. Only Gareth was sitting at the door polishing the hilt of the sword in his hand.
"Good day, Mr. Gareth."
Wall said hello.
